name: Uniti Wireless
summary: Fixed-wireless/NBN retailer, founded 2014, ASX-listed 2019, marketed as Uniti Internet; renamed Uniti Group, delisted via Morrison & Co takeover 2022 (UNITI GROUP PTY LTD, ACN 158 957 889).

events.details: Founded in Adelaide as Uniti Wireless (fixed wireless).
ASX-listed (UWL) from 13 Feb 2019 (as Uniti Wireless, renamed Uniti Group 25 Sep 2019); taken private 5 Aug 2022 via scheme of arrangement (Morrison & Co-led consortium, $5.00/share).
